description.value: Big Orange is a Canadian bubble tea franchise founded in 1996, offering fresh fruit bubble teas, smoothies, slushes, ice cream bubble teas, and Belgium waffles. The North Vancouver outlet is located inside Capilano Mall on Marine Drive, one of roughly two dozen franchise locations across BC, Ontario, the US, and Malaysia. Cyclists looking for a cold, fruit-based drink on a warm day would find a wide variety of refreshing options here.

address.value: Unit 28, 935 Marine Drive, North Vancouver, BC V7P 1S3
